filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Sun Oct 18 – Mon Oct 19 PT

market_briefing.lede: Agent governance moved from policy talk to identity-and-permission plumbing on Monday, while the enterprise adoption gap stayed wide. Microsoft introduced task-scoped Dynamic Permissions and risk-driven conditional access for agents, including locally run coding agents; a 10K ecosystem read shows Agentforce skills demand up 63% YoY even as nearly half of surveyed Salesforce customers remain in testing or pilot.

bullets.text: Agents as insiders: Microsoft (Oct 19) is introducing Dynamic Permissions (task-scoped, time-bound, verified human approval for higher-impact actions), Dynamic Agent Risk and Dynamic Conditional Access for agents, extending Entra Agent ID to local and previously unknown agents, and expanding discovery to 60 local agent types including Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and GitHub Copilot.

Hiring ahead of production: Agentforce now appears in 9% of Salesforce job listings (up from 5%) with demand up 63% YoY, while overall Salesforce talent demand fell 13% in 2026 and nearly half of surveyed customers are still testing or piloting (Oct 19). The 10K report counts skill mentions in listings, not net-new roles.

Voice sales agents get a public-company entrant: monday.com launched Harmony (Oct 19), which runs full sales calls on task-specific small LLMs (~200ms latency and up to 70% contact rate are company claims), with warm transfers to reps and native CRM write-back; live in the US, UK, Australia and Singapore.

biggest_ai_news.title: Microsoft treats agents as “newest insiders” with dynamic permissions and risk
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 19: Project Perception Guardian Agents plus Dynamic Permissions, Dynamic Agent Risk and Dynamic Conditional Access; Entra Agent ID extended to local and unknown agents; discovery now covers 60 local agent types (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot). No GA dates given in the post.

biggest_ai_news.title: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to a new Public Benefit Fund
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 18: subject to stockholder approval, plus up to 2% more per 50% value increase above a baseline (board discretion); wholly-owned LLC, no lobbying or political giving; ~20% of shares dedicated to public good with prior pledges.

biggest_ai_news.title: Microsoft pulls out of Nscale's Essex AI datacentre
biggest_ai_news.body: Oct 18: anchor tenant exits after the grid operator said full power may not arrive until the early-to-mid 2030s; Nscale says it remains committed and Microsoft stays on its Norway project.

what_changed.title: Microsoft ships an agent-insider control model (identity, task-scoped permissions, dynamic risk)
what_changed.body: NEW (platform governance). Oct 19: Dynamic Permissions, Dynamic Agent Risk, Dynamic Conditional Access, Guardian Agents; Entra Agent ID for local/unknown agents; discovery of 60 local agent types. Why it matters: enterprise buyers get a concrete permission/approval pattern to hold every agent vendor to, including sales and CS agents acting in CRM.

what_changed.title: Salesforce commits $1B to Spain with a Forward Deployed Engineer team
what_changed.body: NEW (watchlist, soft). Oct 19: five-year investment; new Madrid EMEA South HQ hosts an AI Implementation Team of Forward Deployed Engineers for agentic use cases plus a regional graduate training center. Investment/footprint, not a product launch.

what_changed.title: Agentforce skills demand outruns production adoption
what_changed.body: NEW (ecosystem read). Oct 19: Salesforce Ben on 10K's Salesforce Ecosystem Report — Agentforce demand +63% YoY, 9% of listings; overall Salesforce talent demand −13% in 2026; nearly half of surveyed customers still in testing/pilot. Third-party.

what_changed.title: monday.com launches Harmony voice AI sales agents
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 19: built on OneAI voice tech and Twilio; prospecting through qualification, objection handling and warm transfer; branded caller ID, power/predictive dialing, consent controls, CRM write-back. Performance figures are company claims.

what_changed.title: WisdomAI Owls: always-on AI analysts assigned business goals
what_changed.body: NEW (category). Oct 19: e.g. close a quarterly revenue gap — finds at-risk deals, recommends focus, updates CRM and sends rep next steps after approval, reports weekly; Slack/Teams surface; beta early November.

watch.title: Salesforce's October GAs: Agent Optimizer and AI Skills
watch.body: Twelve days left in October and still no public GA flag or pricing for Agent Optimizer (beta through account executives since Sep 21) or AI Skills in Agentforce Coworker (pilot), both promised for October '26. Hunter stays in pilot with ZoomInfo and Demandbase now both named flagship data partners (Oct 15). Watch release notes and the newsroom for status and Flex Credit pricing before month-end.

interpretation.fact: Microsoft introduced Dynamic Permissions, Dynamic Agent Risk and Dynamic Conditional Access for agents and expanded local-agent discovery to 60 types (Oct 19). Salesforce committed $1B to Spain with a Forward Deployed Engineer team (Oct 19). Salesforce Ben, citing 10K, reported Agentforce skills demand +63% YoY while nearly half of surveyed customers remain in testing/pilot (Oct 19). monday.com launched Harmony voice AI sales agents and WisdomAI announced Owls (Oct 19). Anthropic created a Public Benefit Fund (Oct 18); Microsoft exited Nscale's Essex datacentre (Oct 18).
interpretation.note: Light interpretation: with Agentforce adoption stuck between skills hiring and production, and Microsoft now publishing a concrete task-scoped permission model for every agent, the procurement bar for GTM agents is shifting toward provable scoped authority, approvals and audit — and Salesforce is answering the deployment gap with forward-deployed services rather than a new SKU.
